subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should this issue stay gated on a live macOS LaunchAgent Claude CLI OAuth reproduction before maintainers accept or request a code fix?
rationale: The source path matches the report, but the decisive failure depends on Claude CLI, macOS service context, OAuth state, and loopback MCP behavior that this read-only review cannot prove from source alone.

options.title: Run the live service-context repro
options.body: Use a credentialed macOS gateway setup to compare managed cron/channel execution against same-environment Claude CLI replay with and without OpenClaw MCP before choosing the fix boundary.

options.title: Limit current PR work to the recovery-copy issue
options.body: Treat the open Claude CLI OAuth-hint PRs as useful for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97553 while keeping this issue open for the distinct gateway-service 401.

options.title: Wait for reporter artifacts
options.body: Ask the reporter to attach the full redacted wrapper log, MCP config, system prompt, stdin, and Claude stream output before deeper maintainer investigation.

recommendation.title: Run the live service-context repro
recommendation.body: Use a credentialed macOS gateway setup to compare managed cron/channel execution against same-environment Claude CLI replay with and without OpenClaw MCP before choosing the fix boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent history put Vincent closest to the checked-out Claude CLI backend, env isolation, and live-session implementation that need proof review.
